references.text: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. God, you are my God; I seek you early. My soul thirsts for you; my flesh longs for you in a dry and weary land where there is no water.

Behold, you are nothing, and your work is of emptiness. An abomination is what you choose. I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come. From the rising of the sun he calls upon my name. And he shall come over rulers as if they were mortar, like a potter treading clay.

Thus says the Lord God: Watch out for the sheep that are being slaughtered, whose owners slaughter them without feeling guilty. Those who sell them say, 'Blessed be the Lord, I have become rich!' And their own shepherds do not spare them.
